behaviors.behavior: A config whose top-level JSON is not an object (null / [] / 123 / bare string) reads INERT_MODE instead of raising AttributeError on .get('mode')
A non-UTF-8 config reads INERT_MODE instead of raising UnicodeDecodeError (a ValueError, not a JSONDecodeError)
JSON nested past the interpreter recursion limit reads INERT_MODE instead of raising RecursionError (a RuntimeError, caught by neither the old guard nor a widening to ValueError alone)
After each such failure the full resolver path (effective_mode -> resolve_gate_policy) still returns a usable answer with should_stop=True
A project_root that is not path-like reads INERT_MODE instead of raising TypeError from Path()
behaviors.evidence: test_gate_policy.py::test_read_run_config_mode_answers_for_a_project_root_it_cannot_read PASSED; verified falsifiable - the same call raised TypeError against the pre-fix code

behaviors.behavior: A FILE standing where project_root should be reads INERT_MODE (absence decided by the read, not the removed exists() pre-check)
A UTF-8-BOM config carrying the explicit literal mode:single_session ACTIVATES (SINGLE_SESSION), agreeing with the orchestrator's sibling reader instead of demoting to INERT
behaviors.evidence: test_gate_policy.py::test_read_run_config_mode_tolerates_a_utf8_bom PASSED - the one permissive-direction behavior in this diff

behaviors.behavior: A UTF-8-BOM config WITHOUT that literal still reads INERT_MODE (the permissive change cannot widen beyond the explicit literal)
Round-trip: a mode written by a producer reads back identically under both utf-8 and utf-8-sig write encodings (touches_io_boundary contract)
Pre-existing gate semantics are unchanged: only the explicit single_session literal activates, and a constitution-locked gate is never auto-answered
behaviors.evidence: test_gate_policy.py full file 36 passed; shared/tests 8187 passed 28 skipped 0 failed; plugins/shipwright-run 247 passed (config/mode/corrupt selection)

behaviors.reason: A prose accuracy claim has no runtime surface; it was verified instead by the Stage-1 spec-reviewer, which REJECTED the first wording for overstating parity and PASSED the corrected one after checking every factual claim against source.

surface_verification.detail: The affected surface is the resolve_gate_policy CLI, exercised through its own suites (test_gate_policy.py + test_gate_catalog_doc_sync.py, 39 tests, exit 0). Separately, the reported symptom was reproduced and cleared end-to-end against the REAL CLI: with a non-UTF-8 shipwright_run_config.json, `resolve_gate_policy.py --gate project.interview` died pre-fix with an uncaught UnicodeDecodeError traceback, and post-fix returns effective_policy=interactive, should_stop=true at exit 0. Same for null / [] / 123 configs.
